tagline: A desktop terminal built for day-to-day ops
summary: Manage local Git Bash and SSH sessions in one window. Drag-and-drop upload, click to browse and preview, right-click download and cross-server send, Find, server metrics, Task Manager, and tab directory shortcuts — less switching between terminal and file manager.
feature.dragUpload.title: Drag & drop upload
feature.dragUpload.desc: Drop files onto an SSH terminal or tab to upload via SFTP into the current remote directory.
feature.clickBrowse.title: Click to browse & preview
feature.clickBrowse.desc: Click directories from ls to enter them; click files to open in the preview panel (text, Markdown, CSV, images, PDF) with full-text search for text.
feature.contextTransfer.title: Download & cross-server send
feature.contextTransfer.desc: Right-click files or folders from ls to download or send to another SSH host; or use Ctrl/Cmd+click / drag onto a target tab.
feature.tabShortcuts.title: Tab directory shortcuts
feature.tabShortcuts.desc: Use ~ on a tab to go home; colored folders cd to favorite paths. Right-click to edit; delete asks for confirmation.
feature.bookmarksTransfer.title: Bookmarks & transfers
feature.bookmarksTransfer.desc: Save SSH connections with OS icons; the transfer panel shows progress and per-task cancel.
feature.hostStats.title: Server resources
feature.hostStats.desc: Open from the side rail to view CPU, memory, disk, network, and system info for the active tab, with charts and auto-refresh.
feature.find.title: Find files
feature.find.desc: Run find in the active tab’s environment from the side rail (Git Bash required on Windows local). Click results to enter or preview.
feature.taskManager.title: Task Manager
feature.taskManager.desc: View processes, ports, memory, and CPU for the active machine (local or SSH). Search, sort, and end processes after confirm.
feature.commandNav.title: Command guide
feature.commandNav.desc: Browse ops commands by service, logs, disk, network, and more. Fill parameters and insert into the terminal (does not auto-run).
step.local.text: First sidebar item opens a Git Bash local terminal (install Git for Windows on Windows).
step.ssh.text: Use + on the tab bar or a sidebar bookmark to connect to a remote Linux host.
step.bookmark.text: Save frequent SSH hosts as bookmarks. Right-click ls paths to download, preview, or send elsewhere.
